**Why the model gave a low‑risk decision**  
The model looks at a few key pieces of your credit profile. First, your revolving‑credit utilization is very low (about 6 % of your available credit). This low usage signals that you are not relying heavily on borrowed money, which pulls your default risk down. Second, you have four open credit lines and loans. Having several accounts in good standing shows lenders you can manage multiple obligations, further reducing risk. Finally, you have no recent 30‑ to 59‑day past‑due items, which again signals strong payment behavior. Together, these factors lead the model to label you as “low risk” with an estimated 12.7 % chance of default.

**How you could improve further**  
At this time, the system did not identify any feasible, verified actions that would reliably shift the decision. Your current habits—low credit utilization, a healthy mix of open accounts, and no recent late payments—are already strong. Continuing to keep utilization low and maintaining on‑time payments will help you stay in good standing.
